name: CDN Bull
author: CDN Bull

sections.description:
CDN Bull is a simple, yet powerful CDN service that is easy to use, needs minimal configuration, and best of all helps improve site performance for a faster load time. You can find more information on our web site CDN Bull

Boost your website performance globally and prevent downtime with CDN Bull! A content delivery network is a geographically distributed group of servers optimized to deliver static content to end users.

A content delivery network (CDN) is a network of distributed edge servers, which accelerate your content around the globe. The main benefits of a CDN are scalability, reliability and performance. The CDN Bull plugin helps you to quickly and easily integrate a CDN on WordPress.

Privacy Policy | Terms and Conditions

Features

  • Fast and reliable support
  • Link assets to load from a CDN (images, videos, javascripts, css, compressed files and all media files)
  • Set included directories (directories or extensions)
  • Define exclusions (directories or extensions)
  • Fastest upload time
  • Easy and friendly usage
  • Simple and basic management interface
  • Easily process tracking
  • Best price of the CDN market

System Requirements

  • PHP >=7.0
  • WordPress >=4.6

External services

PayPal Donate SDK

  • The plugin utilizes PayPal’s Donate SDK to render donation buttons.
  • The script is loaded from: https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js.
  • This SDK enables secure and seamless donation processing via PayPal.

Contribute

  • Anyone is welcome to contribute to the plugin on [GitHub]
  • Please merge (squash) all your changes into a single commit before you open a pull request.

Author

  • CDN Bull
sections.faq:
What it does?

The WordPress plugin has been developed to link your content to the CDN URLs.

Is CDN Bull plugin free?

The CDN Bull free but our service is paid.
